This is a **strategy-first landing page role, not a website development or coding role**. You will understand the client's business, product or service, target audience, and campaign objective before planning the user journey and designing pages using AI-powered tools.

You will take ownership of the process from research and funnel planning to strategy documentation, client approval, AI-assisted UI design, launch coordination, and post-launch optimization.

We are looking for someone who can explain not just how a landing page should look, but **why each section exists, how it supports the campaign goal, and how the page encourages visitors to enquire**.

What You’ll Do1. Business, Offer & Audience Research

* Understand the client's business, main product or service, unique selling proposition (USP), and competitive advantages.
* Clarify the business goal and campaign objective, such as phone calls, WhatsApp enquiries, form submissions, or bookings.
* Define the target audience, including customer needs, pain points, motivations, objections, and reasons to trust the business.
* Research competitor landing pages, advertising messages, offers, and conversion approaches.
* Identify gaps in the client's current messaging and opportunities to improve relevance, clarity, and conversion potential.

2. Funnel Planning & Customer Journey

* Plan the complete conversion journey from advertisement to landing page, enquiry form or contact action, and thank-you page.
* Ensure the landing page message matches the advertisement that brought the visitor to the page.
* Define the next action visitors should take at each stage of the journey.
* Identify potential points of confusion, hesitation, or drop-off and recommend ways to address them.
* Align the landing page experience with the campaign objective and the client's sales process.

3. Landing Page Strategy & Structure

* Plan the page structure based on audience needs, offer strength, customer intent, and conversion goals.
* Define the purpose and content of key sections, including headlines, offers, benefits, proof points, FAQs, and calls to action.
* Plan the messaging hierarchy so visitors quickly understand what is offered, who it is for, and why they should take action.
* Recommend trust-building elements such as customer reviews, testimonials, case studies, certifications, and relevant business credentials.
* Plan enquiry forms and conversion actions that make it easy for visitors to contact the business.
* Explain the reasoning behind section order, content choices, CTA placement, and trust elements rather than relying on generic templates.

4. Strategy Documentation, Wireframes & Client Approval

* Prepare a clear landing page strategy document that explains the business objective, audience, offer, funnel journey, and recommended page structure.
* Create wireframes or structured page layouts to communicate the proposed user journey and information hierarchy.
* Document the purpose of each section, key messaging requirements, conversion actions, and credibility elements.
* Identify missing information and prepare focused questions for the client.
* Present the strategy in simple, professional language that clients can understand and approve.
* Incorporate relevant client feedback and obtain approval before proceeding with the final page design.

5. AI-Assisted Landing Page & UI Design

* Use AI-powered design tools to turn the approved strategy and wireframes into landing page UI.
* Create clean, conversion-focused layouts that support the campaign objective and user journey.
* Follow a mobile-first approach to ensure landing pages work effectively on smartphones and other screen sizes.
* Maintain consistency between ad messaging, landing page content, visual hierarchy, and calls to action.
* Review AI-generated designs for usability, content clarity, layout consistency, and conversion flow.
* Refine the design based on the approved strategy rather than allowing visual preferences to drive decisions.

* Coordinate with the advertising team and developers to prepare landing pages for launch.
* Communicate page structure, content requirements, design specifications, and conversion actions clearly.
* Help ensure that forms, call buttons, WhatsApp links, thank-you pages, and other conversion elements function as intended.
* Work with the relevant team to confirm enquiry tracking and campaign measurement are set up correctly.
* Support the team in identifying issues that may affect the visitor experience or lead tracking.

7. Performance Review & Conversion Optimization

* Review post-launch performance using available campaign and analytics data.
* Evaluate enquiries, conversion rates, user drop-off, and other relevant performance indicators.
* Identify potential improvements to messaging, offers, page structure, forms, CTAs, and trust elements.
* Recommend and prioritize changes based on campaign objectives and observed performance.
* Collaborate with the advertising and development teams to implement and evaluate improvements.
* Use performance feedback to make future landing page strategies more effective.

* Advertising campaign dashboards

title: AI Video Annotator
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for detail-oriented annotators to help label robot manipulation videos for AI training purposes. You'll watch short videos of robots performing manipulation tasks (filmed from three synchronized camera angles) and produce precise, structured, natural-language descriptions of the actions taking place. This work directly supports the development of robotics AI models and requires strong written English, sharp observational skills, and the discipline to follow a detailed style guide consistently.

**Project Details:**

* Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotator
* Location: Remote in India/Philippines
* Employment type: Freelance
* Pay Rate: US$3.5/hour

**What You'll Do**

1. Watch short robot manipulation videos, each filmed from three synchronized camera views (an overhead view and views from each of the robot's two wrist-mounted cameras).

2. Break each video into time segments and write clear, natural-language descriptions for each segment.

3. Apply labels at three levels of detail for each applicable segment:

* Atomic motion (a few seconds) — a single small movement (e.g., "close fingers around the red handle")
* Skill / subtask (several seconds to ~20 seconds) — a complete, meaningful action (e.g., "pick up the red block by its edge")
* Task / goal (up to ~1 minute) — the overall purpose of a sequence of skills (e.g., "place all blocks in the container")

4. Ensure every moment of video is covered by a label at two or more of these levels — no gaps, including idle or pause moments.

5. Accurately describe exactly what happens, including when something doesn't go as planned (a dropped object, a failed grasp, a slipped grip). Precision matters more than making the robot look successful.

6. Cross-reference all three camera angles: use the overhead view to understand the overall scene and object identity, and the close-up wrist views to confirm exact contact and grasp details.

7. Follow a detailed style guide covering vocabulary for actions, spatial relationships, object descriptions, and manner of movement, applying it consistently across many episodes.

8. Participate in periodic calibration sessions to align your labeling with the team and the client's reference examples.

**What We're Looking For**

Required:

1. Strong written English — you'll write dozens of short, precise descriptive sentences per video and need to vary your language rather than repeating the same phrases.

2. Sharp attention to detail — able to distinguish small differences (a successful grasp vs. a fumble, a push vs. a drag, which specific object part is being touched).

3. Comfort following a detailed, structured style guide and applying it consistently, even in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios.

4. Basic comfort with spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, naming object parts like handles, lids, or edges).

5. Reliable, self-directed work habits — this is often heads-down work with periodic check-ins rather than close supervision.

Nice to Have:

1. Prior experience with video annotation, data labeling, transcription, or QA work.

2. Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation) — helpful but not necessary, as the style guide is self-contained.

3. Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio.

title: Outbound Calling Officer
description:
**About the Company**
---------------------


Turning marketing into a market\-domination weapon, we created a new category — the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e\-commerce: full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. We are the \#1 lead marketplace in the USA, and we are accelerating.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


We are looking for an Outbound Calling Officer to proactively contact property owners, buyers, sellers, investors, landlords, and tenants, and turn those conversations into qualified opportunities.


This role is not about "making calls." It is about disciplined outbound prospecting, sharp qualification, accurate CRM documentation, and timely follow\-up — at high volume, without losing quality. The core performance standard is a minimum of 300 outbound call attempts per working day.

**Requirements**
----------------

* High school / intermediate qualification, bachelor's degree, or equivalent education
* 2\-3 years of experience in outbound calling, telesales, telemarketing, customer service, lead generation, or appointment setting
* Neutral US accent and confident, professional phone communication with US\-based leads
* Experience in real estate, property acquisition, brokerage, mortgage, or investor lead generation is highly desirable
* Excellent verbal communication, active listening, questioning, and objection\-handling skills
* Comfort working with CRM systems, dialers, spreadsheets, and productivity tools
* Ability to sustain high\-volume outbound activity in a target\-driven environment while maintaining accuracy and professionalism

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

**Outbound prospecting \& lead generation**

* Make a minimum of 300 outbound call attempts per working day using the company\-approved dialer, CRM, and lead lists
* Contact prospective buyers, sellers, property owners, investors, landlords, tenants, and other assigned real estate leads
* Use approved scripts and talk tracks while keeping a natural, professional, consultative conversation style
* Present the company and its services accurately, identify interest, and establish the appropriate next step
* Generate qualified opportunities and transfer or assign them to the relevant Representative
* Schedule property discussions and callbacks in line with campaign requirements

**Lead qualification**

* Ask structured discovery questions to determine property ownership, location, property type, transaction objective, motivation, timeline, and decision\-making authority
* Capture pricing expectations, property condition, financing status, and preferred communication method where relevant
* Distinguish qualified, nurture, callback, disqualified, and do\-not\-contact outcomes per the approved qualification framework
* Escalate high\-intent or time\-sensitive opportunities promptly

**CRM, follow\-up \& data management**

* Disposition 100% of completed call attempts and record accurate notes for meaningful conversations
* Update contact, property, qualification, callback, and appointment information immediately after each interaction
* Complete scheduled callbacks and follow\-ups within the committed timeframe
* Maintain confidentiality and protect customer, property, and company information

**Communication \& compliance**

* Communicate clearly and confidently, including when handling rejection, objections, or difficult conversations
* Use approved objection\-handling techniques without misleading, exaggerated, or unverified representations
* Observe company policies, consent requirements, do\-not\-contact procedures, data privacy controls, and telemarketing rules for the relevant market
* Participate in coaching, call calibration, quality reviews, and product training, and apply feedback consistently

**How Performance Is Measured**
-------------------------------


Performance is assessed through a balanced combination of activity, quality, conversion, data discipline, and schedule compliance.

* Daily outbound call attempts — minimum 300 per working day (30%)
* Qualified leads generated — campaign target set by management (20%)
* Quality Assurance score — 95% or above (15%)
* CRM documentation accuracy — 95% or above (15%)
* Schedule adherence \& attendance — 95% or above (10%)


Volume benchmarks: 300\+ calls per day, 1,500\+ per week, approximately 6,000\-6,600 per month.

**Quality safeguard:** the numerical dialing target does not, by itself, constitute satisfactory performance. Repeatedly abandoned, duplicated, improperly dispositioned, deliberately shortened, or otherwise non\-compliant calls may be excluded from productive activity and may negatively affect performance evaluation.

**This is not for you if**
--------------------------

* You treat the dial count as the goal instead of qualified opportunities
* You cannot stay composed and productive through rejection and unanswered calls
* You skip dispositions, notes, or scheduled callbacks
* You need detailed instructions instead of taking ownership of your leads and follow\-ups
* You are not comfortable with a consistent 300\-call daily standard

**What We Expect From You (First 3 Months)**
--------------------------------------------

**Week 1:** Complete systems, script, compliance, objection\-handling, and CRM training; demonstrate accurate call dispositions and supervised call readiness.

**Weeks 2\-4:** Progress toward the 300\-call daily standard while maintaining coaching responsiveness, data accuracy, and minimum quality requirements.

**Day 30:** Consistent activity, lead quality, QA results, CRM discipline, attendance, and measurable progress against campaign targets.

**Day 60:** Sustained performance, improved conversion effectiveness, reliable follow\-up execution, and acceptable schedule adherence.

**Day 90 (the bar):** Successful completion of probation based on overall weighted KPI performance, conduct, attendance, and compliance with company standards.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* **Communication** — clear, confident, respectful, and persuasive telephone communication
* **Resilience** — maintains composure and productivity despite rejection and objections
* **Accountability** — owns assigned leads, follow\-ups, data accuracy, and performance commitments
* **Attention to detail** — records factual, complete, and usable CRM notes and dispositions
* **Coachability** — receives feedback constructively and demonstrates measurable improvement
* **Integrity** — represents company services accurately and complies with approved procedures
* **Time management** — balances dialing volume, conversations, documentation, callbacks, and handoffs
* **Team collaboration** — coordinates effectively with Sales, Acquisition, QA, and management teams

**Working Conditions**
----------------------

* Target\-driven role requiring sustained telephone and computer usage throughout the working day
* Working hours aligned with the targeted US market, and may include evening/night rotational shifts where operationally required
* Calls will be monitored or recorded for quality assurance, training, compliance, and performance management in accordance with applicable policy and law
* Performance targets may be adjusted where there are documented operational constraints such as insufficient lead inventory, system downtime, or approved training

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Direct impact on pipeline and revenue from day one
* Remote\-first, flexible work environment
* Competitive compensation
* 3 weeks paid vacation \+ 5 paid sick days
* Access to learning resources
* AI\-driven workflows and tooling
* Fast\-moving, execution\-focused team

description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

  

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.  

Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.**PURPOSE**
-----------


Coordinates and oversees the resolution of critical incidents ensuring minimal business impact and swift restoration of services through structured processes and effective communication (and triggers crisis management process).**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* As Senior Analyst, Incident Management, you will serve as the operational control tower for Major Incidents and Priority 1 incidents across the Digital Customer Organization (DCO) and Portfolio Service Operations (PSO). You will establish command and control, coordinate the right technical and business resources, and maintain a disciplined focus on restoring customer services while minimizing operational, financial, reputational, and customer impact.
* You will be accountable for the quality and pace of end\-to\-end major incident governance, including impact assessment, stakeholder mobilization, technical and customer bridge management, escalation, communications, recovery validation, documentation, and post\-incident follow\-through. You will support the accountable Incident Manager and ensure that resolver teams retain ownership of technical diagnosis and remediation.
* Reporting to the Manager, Major Incident Management, you will be part of the Digital Customer Organization (DCO)function responsible for service resilience, customer confidence, consistent global incident response, and the continued transformation and maturity of Incident Management.
* You will collaborate with DCO Service Desks, PSO resolver teams, Customer Service Managers (CSO), Site Reliability Engineers (SRE), Service Practice Owners, Product and Engineering teams, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Vendor Management (VMO), suppliers, and senior stakeholders. Through these partnerships, you will strengthen DCO and PSO integration, improve operational handovers, and convert incident learning into sustainable service improvements.
* Lead and coordinate Major Incidents and P1 incidents from declaration through service restoration and formal closure, maintaining a clear command structure, accurate situational awareness, and momentum toward recovery.
* Rapidly evaluate technical, customer, and business impact; validate priority; initiate the appropriate Major Incident or crisis pathway; and ensure compliance with agreed SLAs, OLAs, customer commitments, and escalation procedures.
* Mobilize and coordinate DCO, PSO, SRE, Product, Engineering, vendor, supplier, and specialist resolver teams, establishing clear accountabilities, time\-bound actions, dependencies, and escalation points.
* Establish and facilitate technical, customer, and management bridges, keeping discussions outcome\-focused, recording decisions and actions, challenging stalled progress, and escalating risks, resource gaps, or conflicting priorities.
* Deliver accurate, concise, and timely communications for customers, operations, senior leadership, and executives, clearly presenting impact, recovery actions, workarounds, risks, assumptions, estimated next updates, and service status.
* Maintain a complete and auditable incident record in the ITSM platform, including business impact, chronology, ownership, decisions, evidence, communications, recovery validation, links to related Problems and Changes, and closure details.
* Produce high\-quality Post\-Major Incident Reports (PMIRs), executive summaries, and post\-incident review packs; facilitate blameless learning reviews that identify control gaps, contributing factors, and practical opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with Problem Management and technical owners, ensuring actions are risk\-based, measurable, assigned, due\-dated, tracked, and closed only after effectiveness is verified.
* Analyze incident performance and trends, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, repeat incidents, business impact, communication timeliness, escalation quality, action ageing, and customer feedback; translate insights into prioritized improvement plans.
* Advance the maturity of Incident Management through playbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, templates, simulations, training, automation opportunities, governance reviews, and stronger integration across DCO, PSO, SRE, CSO, VMO, and Service Practices.


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE**
--------------


Preferably 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a customer\-focused service or support role within a large\-scale enterprise environment. Experience should include Customer Support, Service Desk, Help Desk, Call Centre, Incident Management, Service Operations, NOC, Command Centre, or IT Operations. **NICE TO HAVE*** ITIL 4 Foundation/Practitioner, SRE, Agile, DevOps, Lean, Six Sigma, or related Service Management certifications.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical environments such as aviation, travel technology, telecommunications, cloud services, managed infrastructure, SaaS platforms, or financial services, with exposure to executive communications, crisis management, and business continuity processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, observability and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, etc), operational analytics, AI Ops, and Incident Management transformation initiatives.
  

Candidates should demonstrate strong customer engagement skills and practical experience supporting a broad range of services and products at intermediate to advanced levels. Experience or working knowledge of airline and travel industry operations, applications, and customer service environments is highly desirable.**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**
-----------------------

**IT Service Management Knowledge**

* Advanced practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident and Major Incident Management, including interfaces with Problem, Change, Event, Knowledge, Service Level and Continual Improvement practices.
* Understanding of service management governance, SLAs/OLAs, operational acceptance, service transition, risk and control frameworks.
* Proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent, collaboration tools, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories.
* Strong command of RCA methods including 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, fault\-tree thinking, timeline analysis and contributory\-factor analysis.

**Technical Knowledge**


* Broad operational understanding of enterprise networks, LAN/WAN, MPLS, SD\-WAN, VPN, DNS, load balancing, firewalls and connectivity services.
* Working knowledge of cloud, data centre, virtualization, compute, storage, databases, middleware, messaging, APIs, identity, monitoring and application support.
* Ability to interpret monitoring alerts, logs, service dependencies, transaction flows, change records and technical recovery plans.
* Awareness of cybersecurity incident interfaces, business continuity, disaster recovery and regulated or safety\-critical service environments.
* Ability to lead technical specialists effectively without being the deepest subject\-matter expert in every technology domain.

**Management \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Exceptional incident leadership, command\-and\-control, facilitation and prioritization under time pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including executive summaries and customer\-facing updates.
* Strong analytical reasoning, structured problem solving, attention to evidence and disciplined decision\-making.
* Influencing, negotiation and conflict\-resolution capability across teams with competing priorities and no direct reporting relationship.
* Cultural awareness and effectiveness in a global, virtual and matrix organization.

**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**
---------------------------

**Major Incident Leadership:** Establishes control rapidly, sets priorities, drives decisions and maintains momentum until stable service is verified.

**Customer \& Business Orientation:** Understands business impact and balances technical recovery, operational risk, contractual commitments and customer experience.

**Operational Excellence:** Applies repeatable controls, accurate records, measurable standards and evidence\-based governance.

**Problem Solving \& Judgement:** Synthesizes incomplete information, challenges assumptions and makes timely, risk\-informed decisions.

**Process Integration:** Connects incident learning to Problem, Change, Knowledge, Event, Service Level and Continual Improvement outcomes.

**Transformation \& Improvement:** Identifies systemic gaps and converts lessons into sustainable improvements, automation and improved ways of working.

**Stakeholder Leadership:** Influences global teams, suppliers, customers and leaders through credibility, clarity and constructive challenge.

**Data \& Insight:** Uses operational metrics, trends and quality analysis to target improvements and demonstrate benefits.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**
---------------------

* Accountability and ownership
* Customer centricity
* Collaboration and inclusion
* Integrity and professional courage
* Agility and resilience
* Strategic and systems thinking
* Results orientation
* Learning mindset and continuous improvement
* Composure under pressure
* Attention to detail and quality

**EDUCATION \& QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------

* Diploma or certificate in computer science, electronic engineering, telecommunications, or an equivalent local qualification
* Bachelor’s or university degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
* ITIL Foundation Certificate

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

  

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.  

**Flex Week:** Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)* **Flex Day:** Make your workday suit your life and plans.

  

**Flex\-Location:** Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.  

**Employee Wellbeing:** We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.  

**Professional Development:** At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** and **Airport Council International** \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like **Pluralsight** for technology upskilling, **Harvard Business Publishing** for people leadership, **Stanford** for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way.  

**Competitive Benefits:** Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status. *SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self\-identify in the application process.*

Our Library contains structured information about countries, provinces, cities, localities, property markets, developers and individual projects. This information supports internal research, public evaluations and client advisory reports.

We are looking for a methodical and dependable person who can research different markets, verify information, enter it into predefined templates and maintain the accuracy of our Library.

* Assist with creating and reviewing research\-based reports.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to organise large amounts of information systematically.

* Confidence in following up with brokers, developers and external partners.
* Ability to distinguish verified facts from marketing claims or assumptions.
* Comfort using AI tools for research assistance while independently verifying the output.
* Ability to work responsibly with limited supervision after training.

* Economics
* Geography
* Business or Commerce
* Real Estate
* Urban Planning
* Finance
* Journalism
* Data or Information Management

* Enjoys investigating and organising information.
* Questions unsupported claims rather than copying them.
* Can follow detailed templates without changing the prescribed structure.
* Is comfortable performing both research and operational follow\-ups.
* Takes ownership of accuracy and completes work on time.
* Wants to learn about international property markets and global living.

* Depends entirely on AI\-generated answers without checking sources.

title: Senior Detection Engineer
description:
Talanos Cybersecurity delivers managed SOC, identity governance, third\-party risk management, dark web intelligence, continuous autonomous pentesting and security advisory services to mid\-market and regulated organisations across the UK, Europe, South Africa, Botswana and India. We are CREST SOC accredited and certified ISO 27001 and ISO 9001\.

We are building a dedicated Detection Engineering function and this is its founding role. We need someone who can engineer detections across enterprise SIEM platforms and who can also understand a customer's business well enough to know which detections actually matter to them. You will work across multiple SIEM platforms and sectors, with direct access to the CTO and real influence over our in\-house product roadmap.

**What you'll be doing**

* Baseline and improve detection coverage for assigned customers against MITRE ATT\&CK and their own risk profile
* Author, test, version and maintain detection content across multiple SIEM platforms
* Determine the log sources and telemetry needed for a given detection outcome and troubleshoot integrations, parsers and data quality
* Work directly with customers to translate their business risk into monitoring requirements a SOC analyst can act on
* Build the correlation layer that connects our security services to one another (e.g. turning dark web credential exposures into tuned identity detections)
* Track the threat landscape and build a reusable detection library so work for one customer raises the baseline for all

**What you'll need**

*You don't need to tick every box below, but most of these should describe you:*

* 6\+ years in cybersecurity, with real hands\-on experience in security operations, SIEM engineering or detection content
* Deep, practical experience with at least one enterprise SIEM (e.g. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, Elastic Security, Google SecOps, Sumo Logic) and confidence working across more than one
* Demonstrable experience authoring detection logic in a query language such as KQL, SPL, EQL, Lucene, YARA\-L or Sigma
* Strong working knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK used for coverage and gap analysis, not just as a reporting label
* Practical understanding of log sources across Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, identity systems, network, email and EDR
* Ability to hold a credible conversation with a customer about their business and convert it into monitoring requirements
* Clear written and spoken English

**Nice to have**

* Python or PowerShell scripting; detection\-as\-code workflows using Git and CI pipelines
* Purple team experience, or use of Atomic Red Team, Caldera or a commercial breach and attack simulation platform
* Structured, hypothesis\-driven threat hunting experience
* Identity security experience (identity governance, privileged access, privileged account monitoring)
* Cloud or detection certifications (AZ\-500, SC\-200, AWS Security Specialty, GCDA, GCIA, GCFA, GCED, OSCP)

**What we offer**

* Genuine ownership of a new discipline, reporting directly to the CTO
* Breadth across multiple customers, sectors and SIEM platforms
* A funded training and certification budget
* Standard business hours, no shift work and no on\-call rota (with regular calls overlapping into the UK afternoon/evening, roughly 1:30pm\-9:30pm IST)
* A clear path to leading the function as it grows

To apply, please submit your CV along with a short note on one detection you personally designed and built: what it was for, what evidence it relied on, and how you knew it worked.

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹250,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home
